Name: Renee Garner
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

Option 1: Interpreting Visual Texts feels most immediately usable to me. This is because I personally know that, as a learner, I learn best when I have visual aids that coordinate with whatever I am reading. I know many of my learners are the same.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
I am getting better, but TIME is always an issue for me. Even 26 years into my career and 6 years back in the classroom as an ELA teacher, I always seen to push writing aside for more in-depth reading activities. This course has "forced" me to devote more time to writing and I see growth in myself and my students!
